text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Narita Brian experiences a sudden,
sharp pain in her leg, we
rush her to the
hospital for an examination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There,
we learn that the cause is arthritis
in her hip, and that she
won't be able to
race for several months.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that was a good run! Time for a
much-needed rest.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, take a five-minute break, then we'll
move on to start drills.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I should mention, with this spring's Tenno
Sho getting close, reporters
have started
coming again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I would expect them to be here
for Brian since she was
scheduled for the
race, but that's not the case anymore...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy she's not gravely hurt,
but she'll
be recuperating through
spring, won't she?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nothing wrong with taking a break. She'll
be back to crushing the
competition in no
time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, you there!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: What's the commotion?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: What's the commotion?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"What's the commotion"?! Isn't Brian
injured?! So why's she training at
the gym?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Exhale...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Brian!
You're in no condition to be training
right now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's my leg that's hurt.
The rest of my body
is perfectly fine.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: I know that, but you need to rest!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There are still things I can do. You know
racing is no simple game you
can win
without working for it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And I'm racing to win. I run to get to the
finish before anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Brian's always been an insatiable
runner. It
seems not even her injury
can change that.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I'm still worried though.
If your condition
gets too bad, I'll be forced
to stop you
from racing.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I'm still worried though.
If your condition
gets too bad, I'll be forced
to stop you
from racing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
So are you going to stop me doing this
training too?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No, a trainer's responsibility is to
support
their racers. I respect your
feelings more
than anything.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
No, a trainer's responsibility is to
support
their racers. I respect your
feelings more
than anything.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You can train while recovering, but I want
to be around to supervise everything.
We'll explore our options and prepare for
your comeback
race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh... Fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Brian unable to run, we start a new,
special training regimen for
her.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Doing core training will let us strengthen
your inner muscles. This'll
prevent atrophy
while your joints are still recovering.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Exhale... That's three sets. How many more should I do?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
We'll rest in between, but let's do six
more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Got it. I'll do triple that.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Triple?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
While your pain's subsided, it's still too
early to run. So starting today,
we're going
to strengthen your legs in the pool.
That'll put less weight on them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Got it.
Let me just get some tires to tie to
my body while I swim.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Tires?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That'll increase water resistance,
right? I'm
trying to increase muscle
strength, not
maintain it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Only you'd come up with an idea like
that... But hey, let's try it!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Only you'd come up with an idea like
that... But hey, let's try it!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Today we're finally ready to get back to
running!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Today we're finally ready to get back to
running!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But I need you to take it easy.
There's less
impact on the dirt, so we'll
start there to
settle back into things gradually.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You've been practically glued to my side
since my injury. What about
the others?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'm watching everyone else
too.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Besides,
your training is just as interesting
to watch as your racing.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Besides,
your training is just as interesting
to watch as your racing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You're a strange one to get a kick out of
watching someone train. If
that's the case,
I hope you won't mind staying until
sunset.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She makes no compromises with her
workouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What attracts her fans might not just be
her strength, but her endless
hunger to
win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the day comes when Brian is back
to her normal routine.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How long were you gonna keep us
waiting? I know you've been
itching to go
hog wild, you wacky wonder!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Did the doctor say this is okay?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the inflammation's subsided, so it's
no problem.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the inflammation's subsided, so it's
no problem.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And I've been watching her this whole
time. She doesn't seem to be
feeling the
injury or other pain.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sweet,
time to get your run on! Brian's off
to the races!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Watching you train hard through the whole
recovery process, I've
been reminded just
how much you want to win.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Watching you train hard through the whole
recovery process, I've
been reminded just
how much you want to win.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And just like Golshi said, we've been
waiting for this day! Time to
make up for
all the time you've been held back!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And just like Golshi said, we've been
waiting for this day! Time to
make up for
all the time you've been held back!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You don't have to tell me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fearless runner dashes down the track
with an intense momentum.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How will she race in the fall?
I can't help
but start getting excited
again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing is ever easy, is it?
